title: Qud re-audit, material research root and fifteen-aspect planning map: complete history and reuse boundaries
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: complete re-audit or historical research/aspect coordination owner with qualified later scope
reviews.disposition:
The complete32-line re-audit was read. Original five-path semantic reading,5437 recovered files and18 checked bindings are different denominators. The liquid pass's9 full/10 windowed files plus one XML declaration and the body pass's15 records/14 files are bounded traces, not whole liquid/visibility/combat/anatomy/save coverage. Physical fuel volume, usable charge, socket placement, passive light, configured draws and AI scoring differ. A failed bulk request can consume available fuel under that source; it is not a universal YAIR transaction rule. Manager-owned anatomy, slot fit, secondary attacks, recursive unequip and inventory/drop/event vetoes require their actual lifecycle; a label alone does not provide support or recover retained gear.

The earlier no-feat-catalogue adaptation claim was already superseded in this report by actual earned-receipt consumers at its snapshot. Do not resurrect that absence, duplicate the existing cooling/lesson/status seams or promote new retrieval/gripper possibilities into selected packets. Pets remained excluded and the supplied edition was not current retail. Three additional documentation screens and their seven questions are reference routing, not new game source reading. Current [PROJECT](../../../PROJECT.md), [architecture rules](../../ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md), AD36/AD43/AD51 and actual world/actor/stock/clock/publisher owners govern selection. No original export, assembly, source/data range, native actor, current tool, save, install, game or browser was reopened; checked old fingerprints are historical evidence only.

reviews.classification: complete re-audit or historical research/aspect coordination owner with qualified later scope
reviews.disposition:
All32 lines were reviewed. This was a user-authorized five-lane research/design expansion, with distinct implementation audit, book/canon, procedural contracts, references and cross-system questions. Completion of bounded artifacts and coordinator spot checks is not implemented generator/resolver, source-authenticated every-world material catalogue or a native useful product. The [deep round](deep/README.md) is later research breadth, not automatic implementation of its contracts; both reports preserve their own examples, selective source checks and unrun vectors.

Material truth, actor observation, exact canon, functional substitution and original generation remain separate. Available local text does not mean fully read, and a wiki lead is not a pinned essential source claim. Useful quantity/process/known prediction/observed result/output are selected consumer questions rather than compulsory meters. The1366-first laptop target and fixed realm/prestige boundary are historical: current [PROJECT](../../../PROJECT.md), [making rules](../../MAKING_RULES.md), [UI rules](../../UI_RULES.md), AD36/AD43/AD51 govern selected work. Historical sole-writer/subagent assignments do not authorize spawning or a new research wave. No source/corpus/wiki/PDF, runtime, tool install, test/build/browser, save, acquisition or publication was newly performed here.

reviews.classification: complete re-audit or historical research/aspect coordination owner with qualified later scope
reviews.disposition:
All33 lines and fifteen aspect rows were reviewed. The first twelve independent audits, integration strategy, whole-world bank and engine-absorption comparison are distinct historical requested scopes. Finding matrices, dependency DAGs, packet interfaces and source-bank concepts are proposals; their creation/review receipts do not establish gameplay, general source reading, tool adoption or native integration. Efficiency requires actual measurement; file size, model labels or a routing plan alone cannot establish latency, token savings or cost reduction. Targeted source reading must preserve relevant uncertainties rather than invent missing features to fill a list.

The frozen assignments/snapshots and separate revisions retain history without making one coordinator idle/current or granting another actor runtime custody now. The old runtime hold was phase-specific; later [world coordination](../README.md) records delivered source/build scopes with behavior still separately qualified. Current [PROJECT](../../../../PROJECT.md), [architecture rules](../../../ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md), AD32/AD36/AD43/AD51 and selected local/world owners govern actual work. No need to reconstruct every world, create another integrator or duplicate book reading merely to use an old aspect. The500-word target is presentation guidance, not an evidence cutoff. No chat/worker, external code, original source, benchmark, runtime, build/browser, configuration, library/save, commit or publishing action was performed by this review.
